requirement: Describe Anchor as a fully remote Phase II randomized two-group parallel trial comparing the W-SUDs mobile intervention with an education-only control in adults with problematic substance use.

evidence.text: The protocol describes the large-scale randomized comparison of W-SUDs with an education-only control.

requirement: Specify computer randomization after the baseline survey to W-SUDs or education-only control and preserve participant group blinding until debriefing after the final assessment.

evidence.text: The protocol states the timing, two randomized groups, group blinding, and debriefing procedure.

requirement: Define the 8-week intervention and assessments at baseline, Week 4, end of treatment at Week 8, and one-month post-treatment follow-up at Week 12.

evidence.text: The protocol schedules baseline, mid-intervention, EOT, and post-intervention questionnaires.

requirement: Identify the primary substance-use outcomes as number of substance-use occasions, heavy-drinking days when applicable, and percent days abstinent.

evidence.text: The protocol lists all three quantity/frequency primary outcomes.

requirement: Cover substance-related problems and the prespecified secondary domains of depression, anxiety, work productivity, craving, situational confidence, engagement, feasibility, and acceptability.

evidence.text: The protocol names these efficacy, implementation, and patient-reported domains.

requirement: State the target estimand as intent-to-treat in the study population, retaining participants according to randomized intervention and incorporating noncompliance rather than restricting the main analysis to adherent users.

evidence.text: The SAP calls the target estimand intent to treat and explicitly says it incorporates noncompliance.

requirement: Use generalized linear multivariable models to compare groups on change from baseline, analyzing baseline-to-EOT and baseline-to-one-month follow-up separately and adjusting for material baseline group differences.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies separate multivariable change-score models at EOT and one-month follow-up.

requirement: Address outcome attrition by examining predictors of retention and applying inverse-probability weights from separate logistic models for EOT and one-month retention.

evidence.text: The SAP defines inverse predicted-probability weights from time-specific retention models.

requirement: For occasional missing items within a multi-item scale, permit person-mean item imputation only when needed and distinguish this item-level rule from handling a wholly missing outcome visit.
acceptable_values: participant mean for missing scale items
do not substitute for visit-level missingness method

evidence.text: The SAP permits a participant average for missing individual scale items and separately addresses attrition weighting.

requirement: Define the per-protocol sensitivity population as W-SUDs participants using the intervention in at least 4 of 8 weeks and control participants viewing at least half of the psychoeducational fact sheets.
acceptable_values: W-SUDs use at least 4 of 8 weeks
control views at least half of fact sheets

evidence.text: The SAP states arm-specific per-protocol adherence thresholds.

requirement: In the treatment group, examine associations between W-SUDs engagement and changes in outcomes, and report bivariate correlations among changes in substance-use problems, use occasions, confidence, depression, anxiety, and work productivity.

evidence.text: The SAP prespecifies engagement analyses and the domains entering bivariate change correlations.

requirement: Average multiple craving reports within a calendar day, then analyze daily craving with a linear GEE containing categorical week and Week 1 as the reference.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies daily aggregation and the week-factor GEE model.

requirement: Report the planned national enrollment of 400 participants and distinguish that target from the protocol's interim conduct count of 111 randomized participants.

evidence.text: The protocol reports 111 randomized to date and a planned national enrollment of 400.

requirement: Flag for confirmation the link/distribution for each generalized linear model, the primary-outcome hierarchy or multiplicity strategy, covariate selection rules, and the estimand interpretation under retention weighting; do not invent confirmatory success criteria absent from the source plan.

evidence.text: The concise SAP names GLMs and several primary outcomes but does not provide these implementation or multiplicity details.

notes: This item rewards explicit uncertainty handling rather than guessing omitted analysis choices.
